recent_alerts.title: Password spray seguito da login_success
recent_alerts.description: Correlazione: almeno 5 login_failed Windows dallo stesso src_ip e poi almeno un login_success dallo stesso IP entro 30 minuti.

evidence.threat_brief: Pattern tipico di password spray riuscito: molti fallimenti da un IP esterno seguiti da un logon valido. Isolare l account riuscito, reset password, e verificare sessioni/RDP/VPN dallo stesso origine.

recent_alerts.title: Malware activity from EDR export
recent_alerts.description: Match high-severity malware-related SIEM export events.

evidence.threat_brief: An EDR/SIEM malware detection usually means a suspicious binary or behavior on an endpoint. Isolate the host if policy allows, collect the hash/path, and hunt for lateral movement from the same user or device in nearby events.

recent_alerts.title: External firewall deny observed
recent_alerts.description: Match deny actions on firewall events (demo match rule).

evidence.threat_brief: A firewall deny from an external address can be reconnaissance, an exploit attempt, or misconfigured outbound traffic. Review destination port/service, volume of similar denies, and whether the same src_ip appears in auth failures.

recent_alerts.title: Deny firewall verso destinazione hot (demo)
recent_alerts.description: Match deny firewall verso un set di IP pubblici demo considerati "hot" (RFC5737). Utile per hunting di scan/exploit verso target monitorati.

evidence.threat_brief: Un deny verso un IP in watchlist puo indicare tentativi outbound malevoli (C2) o misconfig. Verifica host interno sorgente, porta/servizio, e volume di deny simili. Arricchisci l IP su VirusTotal dalla card alert.

recent_alerts.description: Cynet export with suspicious process activity (e.g. encoded PowerShell).

evidence.threat_brief: Living-off-the-land binaries often mean post-exploitation. Review command line, parent process, and user context; check for lateral movement and persistence.

recent_alerts.title: Cynet malware detection (hash present)
recent_alerts.description: High-severity Cynet malware export that includes a file hash for IOC hunting.

evidence.threat_brief: Hash-backed malware detections are high-signal. Pull the SHA256 from labels, check TI reputation, and scope other hosts with the same hash or parent process.

recent_alerts.title: Burst login_failed da stesso src_ip (spray)
recent_alerts.description: Conta login_failed Windows raggruppati per src_ip. Un IP con molti fallimenti su utenti diversi tipicamente indica password spray.

evidence.threat_brief: Password spray: stesso origine prova poche password su molti account per evitare lockout. Verifica utenti colpiti, geo/IP reputation, e se compaiono logon riusciti subito dopo. Controlla anche EventID 4625 e LogonType.

recent_alerts.title: Multiple failed Windows logons
recent_alerts.description: More than 5 failed logons for the same user within 10 minutes.

evidence.threat_brief: Repeated failed logons often indicate password spraying or credential stuffing against a domain account. Check source IP reputation, account lockout status, and whether a later login_success followed from the same host.
